properties.description:
Implemented all seven UI review corrections; awaiting human review.

- Creation uses the normal Node editor, including Fields, Additional relations, the shared toolbar, Save/Cancel, and owner-backed validation/reference choices. Unsaved drafts are preserved across background board notifications.
- SchemaForm reserves cross-field edge space only for rows that need it; unrelated fields use the complete width.
- Fields and Additional relations have compact, clearly delimited headers. Section children own spacing, leaving scrollbars flush with their pane.
- Chat/workspace uses the shared flex splitter allocation contract. Removed competing grid/fixed-width behavior, contained collapsed-edge guides, and added a shared pane-reveal operation. Repeated nested horizontal/vertical collapse, restore and pointer drags no longer leave gaps or overlap.

Verification: npm run test:all passed (build, 136 backend tests, 114 browser tests). Shared owner tests passed: 7 Splitter and 4 SchemaForm. Original exact reproduction expectations remained unchanged and now pass. Refreshed live application inspected.

Attached evidence includes the exact before/after records, screenshots, live geometry verification, and passing checkpoint/owner-test logs. The first full run exposed a timing error in the new test; it now waits for the notification it is testing before Save. Stale-write protection was preserved.

MVP acceptance remains pending the user. No commit or merge performed.
properties.title: Unify node creation and repair composed splitter layouts
